title: Investment Calculator | Calculate Future Returns – CalcBase
description: Investment Calculator to estimate future value of lump sum and SIP investments using compound interest. Supports USD, GBP & INR.
ogTitle: Investment Calculator | Calculate Future Returns – CalcBase
ogDescription: Calculate future value of investments with lump sum and monthly SIP using compound interest.

acceptedAnswer.text: SIP stands for Systematic Investment Plan. It allows you to invest a fixed amount regularly (monthly or quarterly) into mutual funds or other investments, helping you benefit from compounding and rupee cost averaging.

mainEntity.name: Does this investment calculator account for inflation?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, this calculator shows nominal returns. To estimate real returns, subtract the inflation rate from your expected annual return. For example, if returns are 10% and inflation is 4%, use 6%.
